scan.scope: selected retained config/manifest/runtime/protocol/capture/source-index JSON; bounded metadata only

limitations: Operational bounded known-root/reservation exclusion union only; not a final scientific source identity, freeze eligibility decision, or proof every listed literal root was executed.

Deleted/unretained random test or development roots, inaccessible temporary artifacts, dynamic/environment-supplied values and later concurrent allocations cannot be reconstructed. No exhaustive historical claim is made and no unavailable key is invented.

The original provisional workspace registry is absent. Its retained root-inventory-provenance wrapper and recorded hashes preserve history; historical source paths and hashes were not all revalidated. Null historical sha256 means no source-file hash was retained in that inventory; recorded_in binds the supporting preserved occurrence.

The bounded current scan reads selected JSON config/manifest/run/protocol/capture/source-index metadata at most 2 MiB each. It skips raw arrays, tasks, blocks, requests, journals, large candidate/derived ledgers, archive expansion and old full-inventory rehash. Metadata selection and known field extraction are not full program analysis.

Fixed population, geometry/source diagnostic, bootstrap/default literals and historical protected fixture development roots are conservatively excluded but are not all independent experimental roots. Config declaration alone does not prove execution.

Preparation-time predeclared-decisions statuses are historical reservations; later execution/capture/source-index records establish subsequent execution for roots 202611011006, 202611011007, 202611011009 and 202611011011. Earlier fit/probe roots 202611011001 and 202611011002 also executed. Full-pilot/G9 reservations remain excluded.

Code fixes and exploratory work are ongoing. Controller must union every later exploration/reservation and any retained fixture keys before freeze. This ignored snapshot is outside old sealed source scopes; old registries/data were not edited.

Every root was parsed, checked with type(value) is int and nonnegative, deduplicated, sorted and serialized by Python arbitrary-precision integers; no float/string coercion or JavaScript numeric parse. Consumers must preserve JSON integer tokens exactly.
